text:
elaine: FYI — Acme Bank vendor risk sent an ISO question: they want confirmation whether our ISO27001 scope covers POC/test environments where they might upload test customer records. Need a short, customer-ready applicability statement we can send back.
sam: Quick Q — is this a hosted POC or Dedicated/Private? That changes whether it's in-scope by default.
elaine: Hosted trial on our hosted API, short-lived (2 weeks). They said no PHI, just names/emails.
mike: Security POV: our certified ISMS covers production hosted services and associated engineering/process controls. We do not automatically include ad-hoc customer trial instances unless explicitly added to the LAA.
jordan: To be helpful, we can provide a mapping of which ISO controls are still observed during a hosted POC (access controls, TLS, logging, incident reporting). That helps their VR team.
elaine: They asked if we can sign off that our policies apply to the POC.
mike: We can't change the certification scope ad-hoc, but we can provide a formal applicability statement and cover which controls apply operationally. Proposed short wording below.
liz: From legal — keep it factual and avoid implying certification over excluded environments. Also offer contractual addendum if they need the POC in-scope.
sam: Can you paste the proposed wording here and I’ll send to the customer?
mike: Proposed statement:
"Redwood Inference's ISMS (ISO/IEC 27001) applies to Redwood's hosted production inference platform and related engineering and operational processes. Short-term customer trial or sandbox instances deployed on our hosted infrastructure are excluded from the certified scope unless explicitly listed in Redwood's Letter of Applicability (LAA) or covered by a written contractual amendment. Notwithstanding the exclusion, Redwood maintains key security controls (encryption in transit, authenticated access, platform logging, and incident response) for hosted trial environments."
elaine: This is great. Can we also include what evidence we can provide for the listed controls?
jordan: Yes — offer (1) network config screenshot, (2) TLS certs statement, (3) RBAC policy excerpt, (4) sample logging retention screenshot. Those are non-sensitive and helpful.
liz: Add a line offering a redacted evidence bundle and an NDA if they want deeper artifacts.
mike: Also note KMS usage for Dedicated/Private is different — if they require customer-managed keys or to be in-scope, we route to Dedicated/Private sales.
sam: I'll draft the reply to Acme Bank: short applicability sentence + bulleted list of available evidence and next steps if they want the POC explicitly included.
elaine: Perfect — thanks everyone. Sam, can you post the draft reply in #sales-dm before sending?
sam: Will do in ~30m. deploy-bot: Reminder — please attach the latest LAA (v2025-11) from /docs/compliance when responding.
